pat.heading: API Key (PAT)
pat.description1: Enter your GitHub Personal Access Token.
pat.description3: The following permissions are required: `Metadata: Read-only`, `Issues: Read-only`, `Pull requests: Read-only`.
pat.placeholderChange: Enter a new PAT only if you want to change it
pat.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete the PAT?

notifySettings.heading: Notification settings
notifySettings.draftDescription: Draft PRs are included in the badge and the notification list.
notifySettings.autoRemoveClosedDescription: PRs/Issues that are already closed are automatically removed from the notification list on update.

repos.heading: Watched repositories
repos.description: Configure the repositories to watch and their display colors.

interval.heading: Watch interval
interval.description: Specify the notification detection interval in minutes. Minimum is 15 minutes.

lastChecked.heading: Last checked
lastChecked.description: Displays the latest time the notification content was fetched. If you reset it, the next update re-fetches notifications using 00:00:00 of the current day as the baseline.
